Commentary.Commentary: The score is not a big one and the Windies will back themselves to chase this down. The hosts though will hope for an exceptional performance from one of their bowlers. Can they level the series?

Fabian Allen is down for an interview who says that that that they were trying to execute their plans. Adds that they planned to keep it simple. On the hat-trick, Allen says that he tried for it but it did not happen.

The Windies bowlers were once again very good with their lines and lengths. Fabien Allen and Thomas were the stars for them. The rest did decently throughout the middle overs. However, Bravo and Russell took a pounding towards the end which handed over the momentum to the Lankans.

The Lankan innings never got off to a good start! They lost wickets at regular intervals and failed to forge any substantial partnerships. None of their main batters could cross 30 and at one stage it looked like they would struggle to cross the 130-run mark. However, cameos from Shanaka and Thisara has given the Lankan bowlers something to bowl at.

A strong finish for the Lankans has seen them end with a fighting total! However, it will be the Windies who will be walking off as the happier side but Mickey Arthur did say, it is a dry wicket and should help the spinners so it could be a tricky chase.

A couple on the final ball to close the innings. Very full ball on middle, Thisara flicks it between deep mid-wicket and long on. The fielder from deep mid-wicket gets to the ball but can't stop the batters from taking two. Sri Lanka finish with 155/6.
A single now as Bravo bowls this full ball down the leg side. Shanaka works it to fine leg and gets a single.

SIX! Into the night sky! This is excellent batting from Shanaka. He was looking itchy early on but is finding the important boundaries in the end for Sri Lanka. A low full toss on the pads by Bravo. Shanaka hammers it over deep square leg for a six.
WIDE! Goes for the bouncer but ends up bowling it down the leg side. Shanaka goes after it but misses. Wided by the umpire.
Another full toss, this one is pretty low. Thisara lofts it over mid off for a single.
Another full toss but this time Shanaka finds deep square leg. Just a single.

FOUR! Full toss is not going to help Bravo and West Indies but it is working for Sri Lanka. Bravo bowls one on the pads of Shanaka, he flicks it with power and the ball races away to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Dot to end the spell from Russell. It is a well-directed bouncer outside off, Thisara looks to guide it towards third man but fails to connect. 11 runs from the over.

A couple now! A slower bouncer around off, Thisara looks to hammer it over deep mid-wicket but mistimes it. It goes high in the air towards deep mid-wicket but falls just short of the fielder. They take two more.
SIX! Hammered! Russell misses out on his yorker and bowls a high full toss in the arc of Thisara. He powers it over long on for a biggie.

Tries to be cheeky but misses out. Russell bowls this just outside off, Shanaka moves towards the off side and tries to paddle it but mistimes it. It goes behind and the keeper fumbles too. The ball goes towards short fine leg and they get a bye.
Slower bouncer, it is on middle. Thisara pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
Excellent yorker to begin the penultimate over from Russell. Shanaka can only dig it out towards long on for a run.
Andre Russell is back on. 3-0-23-0 are his figures.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over. 12 from it. Full toss around off, Thisara powers it down the ground. No chance for the man at long on to cut it off.
Low full toss outside off, Thisara hammers it wide of the long off fielder. Pollard there fumbles and allows an extra run.
Full and on the pads, Shanaka works it to fine leg for a run.
FOUR! Whacked! Fuller and around off, Shanaka stays in his crease and whacks it between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket. The ball bounces once and goes into the fence.
Just a single now. West Indies won't mind these. Very full and outside off, Thisara strokes it to long off and changes ends.
Full toss outside off, it is pushed straight to cover-point.
Dwayne Bravo is brought back on. 2-0-7-1 are his figures so far.

Another full ball on middle, Thisara digs it out back to the bowler who tries to field but fails to do so. The ball hits the stumps and goes to long off. A single to finish. 7 and a wicket off the final over of the spell from Cottrell.
Brilliant yorker! It is just outside off. Thisara looks to squeeze it out but misses.
On the pads again, Shanaka looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards the leg side and they take a leg bye.
FOUR! Guided it nicely! A fuller ball outside off, Shanaka moves across the off side and paddles it past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Bouncer around off, Thisara pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Thisara Perera walks out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Here comes the Sheldon salute. Hasaranga fails to do much in this game. A full ball around off, Hasaranga looks to power it over the leg side but ends up mistiming it high in the air towards deep square leg. Hetmyer there does not even move and pouches it with ease.
Full and just outside off, Hasaranga guides it to third man and gets a run. Just 5 from the over, excellent one from Russell.
WIDE! Russell is not a happy man! A bouncer down the leg side. Hasaranga ducks under it but the umpire feels it is going down the leg side and stretches his arms.
Good length ball on middle, Shanaka drives it to mid off and takes off for a single. Cottrell has a shy at the bowler's end and hits but Dasun had made his way in.
Full on middle, Wanindu drives it down to long on for a single.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Shanaka pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid off.

Change of pace from Russell. Good length ball around off, Shanaka pushes it to the left of the bowler and calls for a single but sends Hasaranga back. Russell quickly gets to the ball, picks it and fires the throw at the non-striker's end but he misses as Hasaranga dives to make his ground.
Andre Russell is back on. 2-0-18-0 are his figures so far.
Back of a length ball on the body, Shanaka looks to work it on the leg side but gets hit high on the pads. The ball rolls towards short fine leg and the batters take a leg bye.
Shortish and around off, Hasaranga pushes it towards long off for a single.

FOUR! You can't set a field for this. It is unfortunate as far as the bowler is concerned. It is an excellent yorker. Hasaranga looks to keep it out but the ball takes the inside edge and goes past the stumps and away from the keeper. It races away to the fine leg fence. The boundary brings up 100 for Sri Lanka.
Another length ball around off, Shanaka pushes it towards covers and takes a quick run.
Full and on the pads, Hasaranga looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards short fine leg and they take a leg bye.
Good length ball around off, Hasaranga pushes it towards point. 28 balls since the last boundary.
Sheldon Cottrell is back on. 2-0-17-0 are his figures so far.
A single to end another good over for the Windies! Full and on middle, this is hit towards mid off for one.
Wanindu Hasaranga joins Dasun Shanaka out in the middle.

OUT! Mathews is just short and Sri Lanka lose another! They are in big, big trouble now! Once again it is Allen who does the job. Brilliant from him. A yorker is squeezed out towards him at point. Mathews wants a run but is sent back. He picks up the ball and scores a direct hit at the striker's end. An appeal but not a confident one. The umpire takes it upstairs. Replays roll in and they show that Mathews is just short. His slide does not save him. 150 now looks farfetched.
Run out appeal taken upstairs. The West Indies players are not excited. Well, hang on! Mathews is short.
A good change in length by Bravo! This is short and outside off, Mathews looks to pull but fails to put bat on ball.
One more slower one on middle, it is worked towards deep mid-wicket for one.

Direct hit and it would have been close! A low full toss on middle, Mathews hits it towards mid off. The batters go for one. There is almost a collision between Bravo and Mathews. Thomas has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Full and on the pads, this is flicked towards deep backward square leg for one.
Another dot! So an excellent comeback from the bowler. Only 8 from the over. On a length again on off, Mathews guides it to point.
On off, Mathews pushes it to the right of the bowler. Another dot.
Mathews misses out there! This is short and wide outside off, Mathews cuts but mistimes it towards point.
On the pads again, Shanaka works it down towards fine leg for one.

FIVE WIDES! Bonus runs for Lanka, just what they wanted! Down the leg side, Shanaka looks to flick but misses. It bounces just ahead of Pooran who fails to collect it and it goes to the fine leg fence.
Shorter and aroud off, Mathews looks to push at it but it goes off the inner half towards mid on for one.
On the pads, Shanaka looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. It rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Oshane Thomas is back!
Another slower ball around off, Shanaka works it towards short third man for a single. 3 runs and a wicket from the over.
Full toss outside off, Shanaka hits it between long on and deep mid-wicket. Before the fielder can come in, a couple of runs taken.
Landed around off on a length, Shanaka keeps it out.
Good length ball around off, pushed towards covers.
Dasun Shanaka walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Bravo brings out his dance moves. Mendis falls to a full toss. He has flicked this low full toss on the pads straight down the throat of the deep square leg fielder. Another ball which one will feel is not a wicket-taking one but it has got a wicket. A friendly full toss on the pads, Mendis could've  hit this anywhere in the ground. All he can do is, hit it straight to Powell at deep square leg who takes it with ease.
Good length ball around off, Mendis dabs it down to the keeper.
Dwayne Bravo comes into the attack now.
A couple to end the over. On the pads, Mathews works it behind square and scampers back for a couple of runs.
Flatter and outside off, Mendis eases it down to long off for a run.

Appeal for caught behind but only from the keeper. A quicker one just outside off, Mendis looks to force it through the off side but misses. Pooran does well to collect the ball quite low. He appeals but nothing from the umpire.
Mendis comes down the track, he does not get to the pitch of the ball and ends up chipping it towards long off for one.
Flatter and around off, Mendis comes down the track and lofts it over mid off for a run.
Flatter and around middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Short and around off, Mathews gently pulls it to deep square leg for a run. Sri Lanka are 75/3 at the halfway mark.
Good length ball on middle, Mendis clips it towards deep square leg and takes a run.
A single now as this shortish ball is worked towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Nicely flicked! Just ahead of a good length ball around off and middle, Mathews whips it uppishly through mid-wicket for a boundary. This should release some pressure.
WIDE! Goes for a back of a length ball but the line is not right. It is down the leg side. Wided by the umpire as Mathews fails to flick.
Another run as this length ball is guided through gully for a run, this time by Mendis.
He starts with a good length ball around off, Mathews taps it towards covers and takes a quick single.
Oshane Thomas is back. 1-0-7-1 from him so far.
A quick run! On off again, Mathews pushes it towards covers and takes another run.
Shortish and outside off, this is cut through point for one.
An arm ball and on middle, Mendis looks to drive but it goes off the inner half on the leg side.
FOUR! Nice and fine! A little bit of width on offer and Mendis uses it. He goes back and plays it late. Gets it nice and fine past the short third man fielder for a boundary.
On off, Mathews taps it towards cover and takes one.
On the pads, this is worked towards square leg.
Good finish to the over! Bouncer on middle, Mendis ducks under it.
Good length ball outside off, Mathews dabs it down to third man for a run.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Slightly shorter one down the leg side, Mathews pulls it to the fine leg fence and the ball races away to the fence.
Beaten! Good length ball outside off, Mathews pokes at it with hard hands but gets beaten.
On the pads again, Mathews clips it towards deep square leg and takes two.
Good length ball angled in, Mendis works it towards mid-wicket and takes a run.
Andre Russell is back into the attack. 1-0-10-0 are his figures so far.
Shortish and just outside off, Mendis stays back and taps it through covers for a single. 50 up for Sri Lanka but they are already 3 down. Two wickets have come from this over.
Mathews negotiates the hat-trick ball well as Allen's fuller ball on middle is worked towards deep square leg for a single.
Angelo Mathews comes out to face the hat-trick ball. Can he negate it or will Allen go into the record books?

OUT! CAUGHT! Two-in-two for Allen and he is all pumped up. Perera falls too and Sri Lanka are in a spot of bother now. It is not a wicket-taking delivery though as it is short and wide outside off. Kusal cuts it straight to Simmons at point. He is not going to drop these. Big, big wicket. Allen is on a hat-trick.
Kusal Mendis replaces Shehan Jayasuriya out in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Allen strikes! Jayasuriya holes out in search of quick runs. Allen bowls it slower through the air and lands it wide outside off, Jayasuriya reaches out and looks to mow it over deep mid-wicket but fails to time it well. Powell from that position comes charging in and takes a good tumbling catch.
Goes for the reverse sweep to this ball outside off but fails to connect.
FOUR! Slammed! Poor start to the over from Allen. He bowls it short and wide outside off. Jayasuriya gets down in position and slog sweeps it to the deep mid-wicket fence on the bounce.
Fabian Allen is back on. His first over cost 5 runs.
Full and on the pads again, Jayasuriya looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. A single taken as the ball goes towards the leg side. 44/1 at the end of the Powerplay.
Fuller and around off, pushed towards covers.

Good length ball angled in, Kusal looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards the off side and they go for the leg bye. A mild appeal from the West Indies players but nothing from the umpire. That was clearly going down.

FOUR! Not from the middle of the bat but Kusal won't care. A length ball on middle and leg, Kusal looks to hammer it to the leg side but the ball takes the inside half of the bat and races away to the fine leg fence.
Another ball on the pads, this time for Jayasuriya. He works it behind square leg and takes a run.
Full and on middle, Perera flicks it to fine leg and gets a run.
Sheldon Cottrell is back on. 1-0-10-0 are his figures so far.
Good length ball around off, Jayasuriya looks to drive but the ball takes the inner half of the bat and goes to mid on.
FOUR! This one is caressed. Good length ball around off, Jayasuriya stays on the back foot and creams it through extra cover. The ball races away to the fence quickly.

FOUR BYES! That looked to be way over the batter's head but the umpire doesn't think so. It is a bumper from Thomas which is way over the batsman. He lets it be. Pooran leaps high but the ball goes over him as well. Four byes signaled.
Shortish and outside off, Jayasuriya rides the bounce and taps it towards cover-point.
Full and outside off, pushed towards point.
Edgy run! Full and outside off, Kusal looks to drive but the ball takes the inside edge and goes to short fine leg. A single taken.

FOUR! Whipped! Brilliant finish to the over from Jayasuriya. Russell bowls this full ball on middle and leg, Jayasuriya flicks it with power. It goes past the diving mid on fielder and into the fence at wide long on.
Another change up from Russell. A back of a length ball just around off, Jayasuriya does well to sway away from the line of the delivery.
Quick single! Full and around off, Perera mistimes his flick towards mid on but takes a quick run as he takes Pollard on. Completes it easily.
FOUR! Sprays on the pads and pays the price. All Kusal had to do is tickle it behind. He did that well and the ball raced away to the fine leg fence in a jiffy.
Slower one now and it is just outside off, Jayasuriya spots that early, waits and then guides it to third man for a single.
Russell starts with a length ball around off, Jayasuriya keeps it out.
Another bowling change! Andre Russell is on now.
Brilliant bouncer but equally well negotiated by Jayasuriya. He goes back and runs it down to third man to get off the mark. Excellent first over by Thomas. 2 runs and a wicket from it.
Shortish and around off, Jayasuriya stays on the back foot and bunts it onto the pitch.
Slightly shorter and going away after pitching on off. Jayasuriya lets it be.
Shehan Jayasuriya is the next man in.

OUT! Timber! Just 3 balls for Thomas to strike and Fernando fails once again. After bowling a yorker, he goes for a slightly shorter delivery around off. Fernando goes for a heave on the leg side but is beaten by the pace of the ball. He misses but the ball does not as the stump behind is pegged back. Early success for West Indies.
Nails the yorker this time, Fernando keeps it out.
Good length ball around off to begin with from Thomas, Kusal mistimes it towards mid on for a run.
Oshane Thomas, the hero of the last game, will bowl from the other end.

Length ball on middle, Fernando looks to flick but the ball takes the inner half of the bat and goes between the gap at deep mid-wicket and long on. Two taken before the fielder can get to the ball. 10 from the first over of Cottrell.
Good length ball around off, Kusal pushes it towards long on for a single.
WIDE! Good length ball angled into the left-hander. Kusal looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Good length ball around off, Fernando works it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! This time the short ball is outside off and Fernando has the chance of freeing his arms. He slams it over cover and the ball races away to the fence in the deep. First boundary of the innings.
WIDE! Goes for the bouncer this time but it is down the leg side. Fernando goes for the pull but fails to connect. Wided by the umpire.
Landed around off on a good length, pushed towards mid off.
Fuller ball just outside off, Avishka looks to drive but the ball takes the inner half of the bat and it goes back to the bowler.
Sheldon Cottrell will bowl from the other end.
Fuller and on middle, Avishka pushes it to long on for a single. Good first over from Allen. Just 5 off it, even after bowling a no ball.

NOT OUT! The impact is outside off and West Indies lose their review! Poor decision. Flatter one around off, Fernando looks to flick but mises to get hit on the  pads. They put in a huge appeal for LBW but the umpire shakes his head. The West Indians immediately go for the review. The Ball Tracker rolls in and it shows that the impact was outside off. Good umpiring.
Short ball on middle, Perera pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fernando is underway! Floated on middle, Avishka flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up ball on middle, Perera drives it down to long on for a single.
BEATEN! Flighted ball outside off, Perera looks to heave it away but fails to get any bat on it.

NO BALL! Allen oversteps on the first ball of the game. He starts with a very full delivery outside off. Perera looks to drive but misses. Allen and the keeper appeal but the umpire signals it a no ball. Free Hit will follow. The replays show that Allen's foot was not outside the crease.

We are all set to begin! The West Indies players make their way out to the middle after being in a huddle. Kusal Perera and Avishka Fernando are the two openers for Sri Lanka. Fabian Allen will start with the ball.

Lasith Malinga, the Sri Lankan skipper, says they wanted to bowl first as the dew comes in and it gets difficult to grip the ball. Informs that Udana goes out and Kumara comes in. Adds that they need to be more disciplined with the ball and partnerships is the key with the bat.

Kieron Pollard, the West Indian skipper, says it was really wet towards the end of the game and it was difficult to grip the ball so they want to bowl first. Informs that everyone is fit in the squad and they are playing an unchanged eleven. He hopes to keep them to a low total and chase it down. They need to bowl less extras and the running between the wickets needs to improve.
Pitch report - Russell Arnold says that there are some cracks on this wicket and it might slow down as the game goes on. Says that the team will look to bowl first.

West Indies (Unchanged Playing XI) - Lendl Simmons, Brandon King, Shimron Hetmyer, Nicholas Pooran (wk), Kieron Pollard (c), Andre Russell, Rovman Powell, Fabian Allen, Dwayne Bravo, Oshane Thomas, Sheldon Cottrell.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Avishka Fernando, Kusal Perera (wk), Kusal Mendis, Shehan Jayasuriya, Angelo Mathews, Dasun Shanaka, Thisara Perera, Wanindu Hasaranga, Lahiru Kumara (In place of Isuru Udana), Lasith Malinga (c), Lakshan Sandakan.
Toss - West Indies have won the toss and they choose to bowl first.

West Indies bounced back after a 3-0 loss in the ODI series with a brilliant win in the first T20I. Coming on to the second one, the visitors would look to finish the series with a win. The Lankans, on the other hand, would want their team to put in a better performance and end the series on level terms. They have a strong side at their disposal and the Windies would be expecting a comeback from them. What will happen? Will Windies win the series or will the Island nation make it 1-1? Toss and team updates in a while.
